note: SNCF Intercités de Nuit, one entry per direction. SNCF's GTFS route names are not addresses — route_long_name is "-" (short name "INCONNU") for six of these trains, files Albi–Paris under "Paris - Latour-de-Carol" and Aurillac–Paris under "Paris - Rodez / Albi", and carries both directions plus the portions that split at Toulouse and Brive under a single route_id. So every entry is an oriented { from, to } pair, and `name` is Back-on-Track's own label for that direction — which is what the trainsByNumber enrichment looks a view-map row up by, so the feed's stop list lands on the row it belongs to rather than becoming a second copy of the route. `from`/`to` are the feed's station spellings ("Latour-de-Carol - Enveitg", "Nice-Ville"), matched accent-folded and prefix-wise. Day TGV and TER services that merely cross midnight are intentionally excluded, and buildSleeperTrains additionally requires a named entry's trip to run past midnight — the fullest Paris Austerlitz → Toulouse Matabiau trip in this feed is the 08:27 daytime Intercités via Limoges, which would otherwise have replaced the night train's Montauban routing under the night train's own number. Verified against the live feed by `probe-gtfs --verify-allowlists` (the 'Probe GTFS feed' workflow): the first run matched all 18 and returned 8–16 stops per train against Back-on-Track's 2–5. The run after that rule went in resolved IC Nuit 3750/3751 to the night train — 21:54→06:44 and 22:47→07:22, via Souillac, Cahors and Montauban Ville Bourbon, which is Back-on-Track's corridor — so all 18 entries now address the train they name. Service days from this feed are NOT usable and updateServiceDays stays off: the probe's named-entry table came back `(feed carries none)` for all 18 — SNCF populates no trip_short_name anywhere — so an entry matched on endpoints cannot be shown to address a single train, and its days are a union over everything on that corridor (14 of 18 come out "Daily", including Paris–Cerbère, which Back-on-Track has as a Friday train). Stop lists are unaffected: they come from one trip, the fullest, which is why via-only enrichment is what this source is for.
